interface.borrowed_lifetime: Caller owns immutable 8-byte-aligned read/malloc or read-only mmap storage through handle destruction; frontend tables are copied. Storage must not originate from a declared byte array.
interface.clock_semantics: Preserved source-dependency and delivery sample clocks, not acoustic event annotations.
interface.global_tie_rule: maximum score, then lowest original class ID
interface.pcm: Caller-AFE, 16000 Hz mono signed PCM16 little-endian; maximum 8192 bytes per feed.
interface.score5: Maximum of the frozen 113 original OTHER rows; its original winner ID is mandatory per-frame metadata.

limitations: The selected OTHER maximum can be lower than the full-vocabulary maximum; 17 exposed-development frames already demonstrate this.
An omitted OTHER row can win on unknown future input.
Known-record checks do not establish full probabilities, CTC equivalence, independent FAR/FRR or model promotion.
Original strict cross-architecture bit gate and original FP32 numeric qualification remain FAIL_UNCHANGED. The six-score complementary contract is separately declared.
Hidden140 values are diagnostic only; no acceptance bound is applied to stage19.
Host CPU and own-process memory measurements cover a single fixed input under the recorded same-round paired protocol; they are not physical SSC305 results.
Previously rejected MLP and historical affine/sum-OTHER outcomes remain rejected; no subsequent gate or threshold retuning is claimed.

preserved_history.first_build_failure: Missing existing FFT vendor header stopped compilation. Fixed dependency copying and nested directory creation only; zero model/PCM calls in failed build.

publication: Public repository: exact preparation, execution and audit sources plus aggregate metadata. Generated SDK tree, model/frontend files, compiled binaries, raw audio, private mappings, traces, hidden caches and predictions remain in the owner delivery/evidence bundle.

host_cpu.scope: Same round, alternating paired baseline/full-head mmap versus ACTIVE113 mmap, uninstrumented full offline feed. No comparison with earlier rounds.
host_cpu.statistic_note: Median of per-pair savings, not the ratio of marginal medians.

host_memory.scope: Own process after streaming and before SDK destruction; both mmap, one fixed input.

cross_architecture_six_score_contract.reference: Corresponding retained HOST ACTIVE113 six-score capture; not full-model OTHER or full2601 logits.

hidden140_diagnostic_only.scope: Reported stage19 diagnostic only. The historical frontend-feature tolerance is not applied to hidden140.

selection.data_scope: Previously exposed synthetic/weak machine labels; no independent FAR/FRR claim.
selection.eligibility: Original ctc_weight > 0 and original known-training split.
selection.rule: Sorted union of original OTHER-set maximum row ID over every eligible known-training frame; no top-k, cap, development selection, fitting or recalibration.
